# Sorted Array

Source: [4741](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4741); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Sorted Array](../../api/values/sorted-array.md).

<a id="wiki-4741-n1"></a>

- Sorted Array returns an ascending/non-descending copy ranked by an expression evaluated per original element/index.

<a id="wiki-4741-n2"></a>

- Sorting by negative Current Array Index reverses the source array.

<a id="wiki-4741-n3"></a>

- Sorting All Players by distance to Host Player still includes the host; sorting does not filter candidates.
